title: Device Descriptor
description: Retained payload at ms/<site>/<device>/$meta. Self-describes a device so a dashboard or consumer can discover its channels/points and format them without prior knowledge. Cleared/updated via MQTT retained + Last-Will (online:false) on disconnect.

schema_version.description: Canonical schema version this device speaks, e.g. "1.0".

site.description: Site/tenant id — the top of the topic hierarchy.

model.description: Canonical model key, e.g. "orno.we-516" — links to a catalog entry.

adapter.description: Adapter id@version that produced this stream, e.g. "modbus.orno-we-516@1.2".

source.description: Default carbon source tag for this device's energy points.

accuracy_class.description: Benchmarked accuracy vs a reference meter (from the catalog), e.g. "1.0" — measured, not vendor spec.

channels.description: A device may expose several channels (e.g. circuits on a multi-channel meter). Each lists the canonical metric keys it publishes.
